device_entry.name: 串口真空规
tags: 真空系统与高真空实验
高真空/超高真空腔体与仪器配套
device_entry.description: 用于真空系统压力测量的真空规，可通过串行接口接入控制系统。根据配置可对应皮拉尼规或冷阴极规等规管，常用于实验腔体、真空管线和抽气系统的压力监测。
device_entry.description_en: A vacuum gauge used to measure pressure in vacuum systems and connected through a serial interface. Depending on the configuration, it may correspond to a Pirani gauge or a cold cathode gauge, and is commonly used for pressure monitoring in experimental chambers, vacuum lines, and pumping systems.
